enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping. At 07:45, open eyes. Stretch arms. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over edge of bed. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Take out frying pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Wipe table.

Walk to market. Enter market. Pick up shopping basket. Walk to produce section. Pick up apples. Inspect apples. Place apples in basket. Walk to dairy section. Pick up milk. Place milk in basket. Walk to bakery. Pick up bread. Place bread in basket. Walk to checkout. Place items on counter. Pay cashier. Place items in bags. Pick up bags. Walk home.

Walk into kitchen. Place grocery bags on counter. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Place milk in refrigerator. Take out apples. Place apples in fruit bowl. Take out bread. Place bread in breadbox. Fold grocery bags. Put bags away. Close refrigerator.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living areas
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum cleaner. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under furniture. Turn off vacuum cleaner. Unplug vacuum cleaner. Wrap cord. Put vacuum cleaner away. Pick up items from floor. Place items in storage. Dust surfaces. Arrange pillows. Fold blankets.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Take out cutting board. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables and meat. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote control. Press power button. Select channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Lean back. Put feet on ottoman. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Change channel. Watch TV. Stretch arms. Yawn.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking and playing casual sport at the park
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to park. Enter park. Walk around park. Stop at court. Pick up ball. Dribble ball. Shoot ball. Run after ball. Pick up ball. Throw ball. Catch ball. Walk to bench. Sit on bench. Drink water from bottle. Stand up. Walk home.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on personal projects on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open project file. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Read screen. Take notes. Adjust desk lamp. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue typing. Save file. Close file. Turn off computer.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Take out cutting board. Pick up knife. Chop ingredients. Take out pot. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing video games
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote control. Press power button. Turn on TV. Pick up game controller. Turn on game console. Select game. Play game. Press buttons. Move controller. Pause game. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Resume game. Play game. Save game. Turn off game console. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Remove clothes. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bedroom. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Adjust blanket. Turn to back. Place arms on chest. Remain still. Continue sleeping.
